title: Zesty Bitter Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring lamb, Turkish delight, and bitter flavors, often served as a hangover cure. This recipe combines the tender lamb with crunchy vegetables and a sweet treat.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the lamb, onion, bell pepper, and bitter melon onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and lemon zest.
Broil the skewers for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the skewers are cooking, mix the crushed Turkish delight with a little water to create a glaze.
After 10 minutes, brush the glaze onto the skewers and continue cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional Turkish delight and lemon zest if desired.
